rows.my_view: Base $130 with price ~18% below at $109.89, read as fair-to-cheap.
rows.committee: Fair, leaning cheap given lumpy FCF ($493M FY24 vs $372M TTM) that lifts a normalized yield toward 6-7%, but there is no margin of safety against the $85 bear.

rows.my_view: The revenue plateau is the crux and 'Execution' is the deciding question.
rows.committee: We agree growth is unproven, but flat revenue with rising per-share profit and 16%/40% earnings beats makes this a multiple question, not a quality one.

rows.my_view: Margins were an implied concern given the 30%-to-20% operating drop.
rows.committee: The feared 'reset' is likely anchoring error since FY24's 30% was a lone spike, the real baseline is high-20s, and Q1 FY26 bounced to 22%.

rows.my_view: High-quality niche leader, durable by implication.
rows.committee: Narrow but genuine on regulatory lock-in plus hard-to-replicate radiopharmacy logistics, though concentrated in one plateaued franchise and freshly exposed by two manufacturing setbacks.

rows.my_view: Not stated in the initial thesis.
rows.committee: Retiring ~9% of shares out of FCF into a stock that doubled ($47 to $110) with a clean 0.3x-levered balance sheet is a confidence signal, not just EPS flattering.
Multiple compression on a persistent plateau (26x on a flat business) is the most likely kill and requires nothing to break; an FDA action naming a commercial facility is the fastest-moving one.

rows.my_view: Not stated; the thesis rested on action, DCF, and tagline only.
rows.committee: You are arguing plateau-vs-ceiling on an undisclosed product/segment revenue mix — the single number that settles bull versus bear, and neither side has it.

rows.my_view: The July 30 earnings print settling whether the plateau is a pause or a ceiling.
rows.committee: July 30 revenue growth is the right anchor — above ~8% weakens the plateau thesis; flat again with operating margin below 20% likely ends the growth story.

confidence.label: High
confidence.why: Risks are unusually legible and resolve on one dated binary catalyst, but the deciding segment-mix number is undisclosed, so conviction is high on the posture and lower on the underlying business.

final_verdict: A genuinely good, fairly priced niche leader where the Watchlist call is earned — resumed growth is unproven and the revenue mix that would settle it is blacked out, so wait for July 30.
